heading: CHAPTER VIII.
title: CONCERNING THOSE WHO HAVE OBTAINED A PRINCIPALITY BY WICKEDNESS
exclusions: front matter and dedication before THE PRINCE
notes: High-attention moral-density chapter that sharply separates political security from admiration or glory.
The governing mechanism is not a defense of wicked seizure but a distinction between harms concentrated once and harms that keep multiplying.
Modern examples must preserve explicit moral distance and avoid translating murder or treachery into swaggering leadership advice.
